_doc: Casita counters and built-ins as solid, parameterised volumes on top of the walls STL (which stays unchanged). Read only through src/world_params.py (counter_parts(), house_stl()); consumers: emu/envs.py env_casita (MuJoCo collision boxes/cylinders + visuals, and so the 2D GT/nav raster), nav/maploc, tools/casita_fit, emu tools; lineloc via LL_STL=$(python3 -m src.world_params house_stl). Env KEVIN_COUNTERS=0 disables, KEVIN_COUNTERS=<path> overrides. Frame = sim world (walls STL bbox min at the origin, z up, floor 0). A counter is a footprint rectangle in its own frame (origin, yaw_deg; s/t = local x/y; frame 'world' = identity) with one 'front' side; it expands to a top slab (full footprint, top_z - top_thick .. top_z), a carcass set back from the front by 'overhang' (and from the back by 'overhang_back') down to the toe kick, and a toe-kick plinth set back a further toe_kick.d below toe_kick.h. top_thick 0 and no toe kick = one solid block. 'extra' parts are raw boxes {s,t,z} or cylinders {c,r,z} in the counter frame. 'src' records what is MEASURED (mast image fit 2026-10-21 12:13, camera z 0.99115) vs MODEL (casitahouse31 laser-era Blender geometry, not image-verified) vs ASSUMED (US standard values).

defaults._src: top_thick 0.04 / overhang 0.025 / toe kick 0.10 x 0.075 = ASSUMED US standard (36in top, 24in deep, 1in overhang, 4in x 3in toe kick)
